filters.vaults: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships m WHERE m.vault = vaults.id AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
filters.memberships: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships m WHERE m.vault = memberships.vault AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
filters.key_envelopes: account = :requester AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships m WHERE m.vault = key_envelopes.vault AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invitations i WHERE i.vault = key_envelopes.vault AND i.account = :requester AND i.status = 'pending'))
filters.documents: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships m WHERE m.vault = documents.vault AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
filters.versions: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships m WHERE m.vault = versions.vault AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
filters.version_chunks: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships m WHERE m.vault = version_chunks.vault AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
filters.invitations: account = :requester OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vaults v WHERE v.id = invitations.vault AND v.owner = :requester)
filters.audit_log: (audit_log.vault = '' AND audit_log.actor = :requester AND audit_log.action = 'identity_rewrap') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships m WHERE m.vault = audit_log.vault AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
